Seasonal Effects for the Fenlands
By Rain And Flood
The separation of earth and water blurs in the Fenlands. Thick obscuring mists rise from stagnate bogs, tumultuous rains spill from the 
riverbanks flooding the land, and the squelch of mud is heard with every step. The Fenlands flourish or perish with the weather, and its 
many fauna have adapted to co-exist with the mercurial wetlands, learning to move with the seasons.
The Fenlands are more than centralized locations on the island and can be found spread throughout the forests, mountains and prairies, 
in any land where fresh water reigns. Though there are areas where the Fenlands truly dominate the landscape, the wide lakes of Four 
Moon harbor whole ecosystems of fresh water fish in its shallow depths, the white water Rhaen will break any creature that tries to 
swim against its current, and the glooming Mirewynn welcomes many unsuspecting Travelers to a sinking demise in its muddy pits.

Clear Skies • Calm weather with no effects.
Rain • -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight 
beyond 30 ft.. All Fire damage rolls have a –1 damage

Drizzle • -1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on

Foggy Gloom • -1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely

Iridescent Fog • Marsh gases mix in a kaleidoscope of 
color in the thick mists. -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks 
that rely on sight beyond 30 ft..
Heavy Rain • -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely 
on sight beyond 30 ft..  All Fire damage rolls have a –3 
damage penalty. All Cold damage rolls gain an additional 
+2  damage. Negate the benefits of a Long Rest if 
attempted without any cover or protection from the rain.
Cacophonous Mating • All manner of birds, amphibians 
and insects loudly exclaim their desire to mate. Travelers 
gain Advantage on Stealth checks as the various calls 
drown out anything else across the Fenlands.
High Floods • Rivers spill over onto the banks in tumultuous 
floods. Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, swimming Travelers 
or creatures not native to the Fenlands biome for every 
30 ft. of swimming. Failure: Creatures are pushed 10 ft. 
down stream.
Vigael Saturation • The green algae of vigael spreads 
throughout the waterways. Any creature submerged in 
a natural body of water gains Advantage on Constitution 
Saving Throws. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield 
double the result for Vigael.
Windswept Pollen • Brookbud blossom along the rivers 
and ponds, their pollen blowing through the wind. Once 
per day, a creature that takes a Short Rest in the Fenlands 
can recover an additional 1d6 Hit Points. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Brookbuds 
Leaves.
Uncertain Footing • Laststep Lily’s unfurl their great 
leaves on the lakes and ponds, enticing prey to take a step. 
This Natural-Trap will be encountered more frequently.

buzzing insects thicken the humid summer air. Dexterity 
Saving Throw: DC 10, any Traveler attempting to maintain 
Concentration. Failure: They lose their Concentration as 
they are distracted by swatting away the bugs.
Riverside Yields • Thick and nutritious Pond Wattle

Fetid Water • Stagnant waters harbor festering microbes 
and wriggling larvae during the dry months. Constitution 
Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature submerged in a 
natural body of stagnant water. Failure: Disadvantage on 
Constitution Saving Throws and any healing received is 
reduced by half for as long as they are in the water and for 
10 minutes once outside of it.
Grasping Grasses • Wriggle Weed choke the river ways, 
tugging and pulling anything that gets closed to their 
questing leaves. This Natural-Trap will be encountered 
more frequently.
Drowning Pits • Fenfall Fungus spread across the damp 
soil, obscured by the summer growth. This Natural-Trap 
will be encountered more frequently.

Frigid Rain • -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely 
on sight beyond 30 ft..  All Fire damage rolls have a –3 
damage penalty. All Cold damage rolls gain an additional 
+3 damage. Negate the benefits of a Long Rest if attempted 
without any cover or protection from the cold rain.
Below Zero • Beneath the ice, the water runs cold. Any 
creature submerged for a number of minutes equal to 
its Constitution score before suffering any ill effects. 
Each additional minute spent in frigid water requires the 
creature to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw 
or gain 1 Exhaustion level. Creatures with Resistance or 
Immunity to Cold damage automatically succeed on the 
save.
Frost Bitten Oysters • Cold water sweeps through the 
streams, freezing creekot oysters and slowing their 
ability to close and hide their pearl within. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Creekot 
Oysters.

Frozen Paths • Cold temperatures freeze the surface of 
lakes and swamps, many waterways are now traversable 
by foot. Halve the results of any Foraging Expedition 
results.
Crimson Waters • Blood Twine spreads across lakes and 
swamps, spreading their red-tinged algae profusely 
across the still surface. This Natural-Trap will be 
encountered more frequently.
Unseen Scouring
Nuthorghul feast voraciously to 
prepare for the colder months. 
Nuthorghul gain Advantage 
in Strength rolls. They can use

Tranquil Water
Abundant gurubara saturate 
the rivers with their calming 
algae. Larkiera, silvette and 
murrow have Disadvantage on 
their first melee attack roll of a 
combat encounter.
Leaping Invaders
Wrakis converge on the 
Fenlands in greater numbers 
during this season to feast 
on drought-trapped prey. 
Double the amount of wrakis 
when they are the result of any 
Scavenger rolls. And they gain 
Advantage on Initiative rolls.
